description: This file contains functions and constants related to configuring and managing streaming parameters for AI agent interactions, including resolving extra parameters, wrapping stream functions, and applying provider-specific request wrappers.

classes.name: __testing
classes.description: Object containing test utility functions for setting and resetting provider runtime dependencies.

methods.name: setProviderRuntimeDepsForTest
methods.description: Sets provider runtime dependencies for testing, allowing partial overrides.

methods.name: resetProviderRuntimeDepsForTest
methods.description: Resets provider runtime dependencies to default for testing.

methods.name: resolveExtraParams
methods.description: Resolves provider-specific extra parameters from model configuration, merging defaults, global, and agent-specific params.

methods.name: resolveSupportedTransport
methods.description: Validates and returns supported transport types ('sse', 'websocket', 'auto') or undefined.

methods.name: hasExplicitTransportSetting
methods.description: Checks if explicit transport setting exists in provided settings.

methods.name: resolvePreparedExtraParams
methods.description: Combines resolved extra parameters with overrides, sanitizes, and applies provider-specific defaults.

methods.name: sanitizeExtraParamsRecord
methods.description: Removes potentially unsafe keys from extra parameters record.

methods.name: resolveAgentTransportOverride
methods.description: Determines transport override based on global and project settings, or extra parameters.

methods.name: createStreamFnWithExtraParams
methods.description: Creates a wrapped stream function with extra parameters like temperature, maxTokens, transport, and cachedContent.

methods.name: resolveAliasedParamValue
methods.description: Resolves parameter value from multiple sources, considering snake_case and camelCase keys.

methods.name: createParallelToolCallsWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a stream function to enable or disable parallel tool calls based on configuration.

methods.name: applyPrePluginStreamWrappers
methods.description: Applies pre-processing wrappers to an agent’s stream function, including extra params and thinking level adjustments.

methods.name: applyPostPluginStreamWrappers
methods.description: Applies post-processing wrappers to an agent’s stream function, including caching, payload management, and parallel calls.

methods.name: applyExtraParamsToAgent
methods.description: Main function to resolve, merge, and apply extra parameters and wrappers to an agent’s stream function.
